payout_value_note: Flat $25 to the referring member and $25 to the referred new member. No limit on referrals.
payout_quote: If they open a qualifying checking account of any kind, you both will receive a $25.00 incentive* paid directly into your accounts. Plus, there's no limit to how many friends or family members you can refer!
steps: Current Thrive member submits the member referral form.
New member must open a new checking account within 30 days of the form submission (or a referred new member submits the New Member Referral Form within 7 days of opening).
New member: signs up for direct deposit totaling at least $500 in the first 60 days; keeps the checking account open for at least 60 days.
Both parties receive $25.00 paid to their savings accounts once all requirements are met.
catches: No limit on referrals — but the payout is only $25 each.
New member must open the checking account within 30 days of the referral form.
Friend must set up direct deposit totaling $500+ in the first 60 days AND keep the account open 60 days.
Current members cannot refer new member accounts they are connected to.
biggest_catch: Only $25 each, and the friend must hit $500 in direct deposits within 60 days plus keep the account open 60 days.
eligibility: Thrive Credit Union members; referred person must be a new member opening a checking account.
timing: Form submission ~5-10 min active; $25 paid after the 60-day tenure/activity requirements are met.
